Calcar.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
Calcar.question: The _____ was Spur of cartilage in bats.
Calcar.fact: The calcar, also called the calcaneum, is the name given to a spur of cartilage arising from inner side of ankle and running along part of outer interfemoral membrane in bats, as well as to a similar spur on the legs of some arthropods.
